import json
import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

XLSX = "sales_data.xlsx"


def find_columns(ws, header_row, keywords):
    matches = []
    for cell in header_row:
        v = cell.value
        if isinstance(v, str):
            low = v.strip().lower()
            for kw in keywords:
                if kw in low:
                    matches.append((cell.column, v))
                    break
    return matches


wb = load_workbook(XLSX)
ws = wb.active
header = list(ws[1])
headers = [c.value for c in header]

sales_cols = find_columns(ws, header, ["sales", "revenue"])
profit_cols = find_columns(ws, header, ["profit"])
cost_cols = find_columns(ws, header, ["cost"])
margin_cols = [c.column for c in header if isinstance(c.value, str) and "margin" in c.value.strip().lower()]

sales_col = sales_cols[0][0] if sales_cols else None
profit_col = profit_cols[0][0] if profit_cols else None
cost_col = cost_cols[0][0] if cost_cols else None

if sales_col is None:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "no sales/revenue column found", "headers": headers}))
    sys.exit(2)

sales_letter = get_column_letter(sales_col)

if profit_col is not None:
    numerator = get_column_letter(profit_col)
elif cost_col is not None:
    numerator = f"({get_column_letter(sales_col)}-{get_column_letter(cost_col)})"
else:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "no profit or cost column found", "headers": headers}))
    sys.exit(2)

if margin_cols:
    margin_col = margin_cols[0]
    new_letter = get_column_letter(margin_col)
    mode = "updated-existing"
else:
    margin_col = ws.max_column + 1
    new_letter = get_column_letter(margin_col)
    ws.cell(row=1, column=margin_col, value="Profit Margin (%)")
    mode = "added"

formula_tpl = f"={numerator}/{{{sales_letter}}}{{r}}"

last_row = ws.max_row
written = 0
skipped = 0
for r in range(2, last_row + 1):
    sales_val = ws.cell(row=r, column=sales_col).value
    other = ws.cell(row=r, column=profit_col if profit_col else cost_col).value
    if sales_val is None or (isinstance(sales_val, str) and sales_val.strip() == ""):
        skipped += 1
        continue
    if other is None or (isinstance(other, str) and other.strip() == ""):
        skipped += 1
        continue
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=margin_col, value=formula_tpl.format(r=r))
    cell.number_format = "0.0%"
    written += 1

wb.save(XLSX)
print(json.dumps({
    "mode": mode,
    "headers": headers,
    "sales_column": sales_letter,
    "numerator_column": get_column_letter(profit_col) if profit_col else get_column_letter(cost_col),
    "margin_column": new_letter,
    "rows_written": written,
    "rows_skipped": skipped,
    "sample_formula": f"={numerator}/{sales_letter}2",
}))

import json
import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

XLSX = "sales_data.xlsx"


def find_columns(ws, header_row, keywords):
    matches = []
    for cell in header_row:
        v = cell.value
        if isinstance(v, str):
            low = v.strip().lower()
            for kw in keywords:
                if kw in low:
                    matches.append((cell.column, v))
                    break
    return matches


wb = load_workbook(XLSX)
ws = wb.active
header = list(ws[1])
headers = [c.value for c in header]

sales_cols = find_columns(ws, header, ["sales", "revenue"])
profit_cols = find_columns(ws, header, ["profit"])
cost_cols = find_columns(ws, header, ["cost"])
margin_cols = [c.column for c in header if isinstance(c.value, str) and "margin" in c.value.strip().lower()]

sales_col = sales_cols[0][0] if sales_cols else None
profit_col = profit_cols[0][0] if profit_cols else None
cost_col = cost_cols[0][0] if cost_cols else None

if sales_col is None:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "no sales/revenue column found", "headers": headers}))
    sys.exit(2)

sales_letter = get_column_letter(sales_col)

if profit_col is not None:
    numerator = get_column_letter(profit_col)
elif cost_col is not None:
    numerator = f"({get_column_letter(sales_col)}-{get_column_letter(cost_col)})"
else:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "no profit or cost column found", "headers": headers}))
    sys.exit(2)

if margin_cols:
    margin_col = margin_cols[0]
    new_letter = get_column_letter(margin_col)
    mode = "updated-existing"
else:
    margin_col = ws.max_column + 1
    new_letter = get_column_letter(margin_col)
    ws.cell(row=1, column=margin_col, value="Profit Margin (%)")
    mode = "added"

formula_tpl = f"={numerator}/{{{sales_letter}}}{{r}}"

last_row = ws.max_row
written = 0
skipped = 0
for r in range(2, last_row + 1):
    sales_val = ws.cell(row=r, column=sales_col).value
    other = ws.cell(row=r, column=profit_col if profit_col else cost_col).value
    if sales_val is None or (isinstance(sales_val, str) and sales_val.strip() == ""):
        skipped += 1
        continue
    if other is None or (isinstance(other, str) and other.strip() == ""):
        skipped += 1
        continue
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=margin_col, value=formula_tpl.format(r=r))
    cell.number_format = "0.0%"
    written += 1

wb.save(XLSX)
print(json.dumps({
    "mode": mode,
    "headers": headers,
    "sales_column": sales_letter,
    "numerator_column": get_column_letter(profit_col) if profit_col else get_column_letter(cost_col),
    "margin_column": new_letter,
    "rows_written": written,
    "rows_skipped": skipped,
    "sample_formula": f"={numerator}/{sales_letter}2",
}))
